chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad dari Ibn Abi Najran dari Abdullah ibn Sinan dari Abu Abdillah (alamah) berkata:

Aku bertanya kepadanya, 'Haruskah orang yang memandikan mayit melakukan ghusl?' Ia menjawab, 'Ya.' Aku bertanya lagi, 'Dan orang yang meletakkan mayit di dalam kubur?' Ia menjawab, 'Tidak, karena ia hanya menyentuh pakaian.'
ai.seo_question: Siapa yang wajib melakukan mandi besar (ghusl) setelah menangani jenazah menurut fikih Syiah?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Kafi delineates the distinction between major ritual impurity (janabah) requiring full ghusl and minor contact that does not necessitate it, specifically contrasting the washer of the deceased with the one who buries them. Scholarly commentary notes that while washing involves direct contact with the body's moisture and pores, the burier typically handles only the shroud, thus remaining in a state of lesser impurity. This ruling underscores the practical jurisprudence of handling death rituals in Shia fiqh, emphasizing the physical nature of ritual purity over mere proximity.
